enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Tendon Slice +3: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 3 seconds.
Electrifying 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 2d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Freezing 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 4 to 24 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Armor-Piercing 5%: Passive: +5% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
